# UI5 TypeScript API Reference

> Complete TypeScript API documentation for the OpenUI5 and SAPUI5 UI frameworks, generated from @openui5/types and @sapui5/types npm packages.

Each class page includes the TypeScript import statement, inheritance hierarchy, constructor signatures, properties, methods, events, and associations. All content is static HTML — no JavaScript required for reading.

## Key Libraries (OpenUI5 1.152)

- [sap.m](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.m/README.html): Main UI controls — Button, Input, List, Table, Dialog, MessageBox
- [sap.ui.core](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.ui.core/README.html): Core framework — Control, Element, Component, Model, routing
- [sap.f](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.f/README.html): SAP Fiori controls — FlexibleColumnLayout, ShellBar, DynamicPage
- [sap.ui.table](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.ui.table/README.html): Analytical and tree tables
- [sap.ui.layout](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.ui.layout/README.html): Layout controls — Grid, Splitter, ResponsiveFlowLayout
- [sap.uxap](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.uxap/README.html): Object Page pattern
- [sap.ui.integration](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.ui.integration/README.html): Integration Cards
- [sap.tnt](https://ui5.github.io/typescript/api/openui5/1.152/sap.tnt/README.html): Tool Page, InfoLabel, SideNavigation
